patches_added.name: Hidden Features
patches_added.description: Turns on two finished Gboard features that a resigned build can never receive: grammar check, and a close control on the chips Gboard offers unprompted. Their flags are delivered per app signature, so resigning the APK means they never arrive and stay off. Both are confirmed working on a device; five other flags were tried and dropped.

patches_added.name: Hidden Features (unconfirmed)
patches_added.description: Turns on four finished Gboard features that a resigned build can never receive: Emoji Kitchen browse, the custom sticker tab, offline translation, and search in Gboard's settings. Off by default because none of the four has been seen working on a device — the flags flip, but each also depends on data Google only sends to an unpatched install. Safe to try: none of them crashes.

patches_removed.name: Grammar Check Row
patches_removed.description: Force the grammar check settings row to appear. The Phenotype flag that governs it never syncs on a patched build, so its compiled-in default (off) sticks.

patches_modified.name: Suggested Settings
patches_modified.description: Turns on flick keys for symbols, touch & hold keys for numbers, suggestion strip, grammar check and smart replies, and turns off block offensive words and word suggestions. Written once as defaults, so each can still be changed in Gboard's own settings. Grammar check is the switch, not the feature: the row only exists on a resigned build if Hidden Features is applied too.

patches_modified.name: Text Action Buttons
patches_modified.description: Add Select all, Copy and Paste buttons to the toolbar above the keyboard, so each is one tap instead of opening Gboard's text editing panel first. Registered natively, so drag-to-reorder through the toolbar customize page persists. These three share the toolbar with Gboard's own icons and with Toolbar Hotkeys. Bigger Toolbar, which is applied unless you deselect it, raises the ceiling from five to twelve; without it, five is all the bar can hold.

patches_modified.name: Toolbar Hotkeys
patches_modified.description: Adds eight configurable hotkey slots to Gboard's toolbar — each commits a text of your choice on tap. A slot appears when its text is set; when cleared it hides at the next toolbar rebuild (rotate, switch IME, or restart — there's no mid-session un-register). Text and icon edits apply on the next keyboard open. The slots share the toolbar with Gboard's own icons: Bigger Toolbar, which is applied unless you deselect it, makes room for twelve, but on a stock ceiling of five not all eight fit.

patches_added.name: Mask live ad breaks (black screen + mute)
patches_added.description: Masks Pluto TV LIVE/linear commercial breaks, which are real broadcast time stitched into the live feed and cannot be removed (unlike VOD ads, which "Skip ads" deletes outright). During a live break it covers the player with a black screen and mutes the audio, then restores both the instant the show returns — so gambling, drinking, or any other live ad is blanked and silenced. Detection is driven by Pluto's own ID3 ad-state flow (ID3AdsBeaconTracker), which fires only while an ad plays, so it needs no polling and keeps working alongside "Skip ads". Opt-out: leave it OFF to watch live ads normally; runtime controls are marker files in the app's external files dir — `slate_off` disables it, and `pluto_slate_mode` set to `black` or `mute` picks cover-only or mute-only instead of both. Validated on-device, 5.66.0-leanback.

patches_added.name: Comment sort controls
patches_added.description: Exposes TikTok's native full comment-sort sheet, including its hot, time, media, and creator modes, instead of relying on rollout gates.

patches_added.name: Download stories
patches_added.description: Adds TikTok's native save action to each story's share menu. The current story item is preserved so profiles with several stories download the intended media.

patches_added.name: Enable voice comments
patches_added.description: Enables TikTok's native voice-comment recording and publishing entry points.

patches_added.name: Foldable split comment view
patches_added.description: Forces TikTok's tablet-style split layout (video beside comments instead of a bottom sheet) once the screen is at least as wide as a configurable threshold, for foldables TikTok doesn't already recognize as tablet-class.

patches_added.name: Force show Auto scroll
patches_added.description: Adds a setting that bypasses TikTok's rollout gates for its native Auto scroll action on supported videos.

patches_added.name: Hide suggested accounts
patches_added.description: Removes suggested-account cards from profile and inbox surfaces. Thanks to tymmesyde for the original implementation.

patches_added.name: Share sheet modification
patches_added.description: Adds toggles and allow-lists for the video share sheet's "Send to", "Share via app", and "Video Actions" sections.

patches_modified.name: Always show publish date
patches_modified.description: Always shows the publish date in video author information. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Copy comments without username
patches_modified.description: Copies only the comment text without including the creator's username.

patches_modified.name: Custom offline videos limit
patches_modified.description: Adds a custom entry to TikTok's offline videos menu with a configurable limit from 1 to 1000 videos.

patches_modified.name: Diagnostic tools
patches_modified.description: Adds optional Morphe diagnostic logging, filtered reports, and local TikTok crash capture.

patches_modified.name: Disable login requirement
patches_modified.description: Removes TikTok's mandatory login gate from supported flows.

patches_modified.name: Disable long-press quick share
patches_modified.description: Keeps long-pressing Share from opening TikTok's quick-share interaction.

patches_modified.name: Disable long-press repost
patches_modified.description: Keeps holding Like from opening TikTok's repost action.

patches_modified.name: Disable screen capture detection
patches_modified.description: Prevents TikTok from reacting to screenshots and screen recordings.

patches_modified.name: Downloads
patches_modified.description: Adds watermark-free downloads, video quality selection, comment sticker saving, configurable folders, and filename templates.

patches_modified.name: Enable Live search
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's search entry in the Live drawer where supported.

patches_modified.name: Enable non-personalized search
patches_modified.description: Uses TikTok's non-personalized search mode instead of its saved account choice.

patches_modified.name: Feature Gate Lab
patches_modified.description: Adds a menu for viewing and overriding supported TikTok feature flags and configuration values.

patches_modified.name: Feed filter
patches_modified.description: Hides feed ads, TikTok Shop items, livestreams, stories, photo posts, and videos outside configured view or like ranges.

patches_modified.name: Feed tab navigation
patches_modified.description: Controls which loaded top and bottom navigation tabs remain visible, blocks newly added tabs when requested, and can hide the Tako AI bubble.

patches_modified.name: Fix Google login
patches_modified.description: Restores Google account sign-in after patching.

patches_modified.name: Hide CAPTCHA popups
patches_modified.description: Adds a default-off setting to hide browsing and LIVE puzzle dialogs while preserving login and account verification.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed LIVE button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the LIVE button at the top left of video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed follow button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the + follow button below creator avatars in video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed save button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the save/favourites button from video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide feed search button
patches_modified.description: Adds an option to hide the search button at the top right of video feeds.

patches_modified.name: Hide floating promotions
patches_modified.description: Removes floating promotional badges, coin icons, and timer banners from the Home feed.

patches_modified.name: Hide quick comment reactions
patches_modified.description: Hides TikTok's exposed quick emoji row in supported comment inputs.

patches_modified.name: Hold-and-slide 2x lock
patches_modified.description: Enables TikTok's native hold, slide down, and release gesture to lock 2x speed.

patches_modified.name: Open external links directly
patches_modified.description: Opens profile and story website links in the system browser instead of TikTok's in-app browser. Thanks to lyyako for the original implementation.

patches_modified.name: Playback speed
patches_modified.description: Enables playback-speed controls for all videos and remembers the selected speed between videos.

patches_modified.name: Region spoof
patches_modified.description: Adds in-app controls for changing the region TikTok reads.

patches_modified.name: Remember clear display
patches_modified.description: Remembers TikTok's clear-display state between videos.

patches_modified.name: Resume videos after scrolling
patches_modified.description: Continues supported videos from where playback stopped when returning after a scroll.

patches_modified.name: Sanitize sharing links
patches_modified.description: Removes tracking parameters from TikTok links before they are shared.

patches_modified.name: Settings
patches_modified.description: Adds the Metra patches settings menu to TikTok. Supports TikTok 46.2.3.

patches_modified.name: Show seekbar
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's native video seekbar where it would normally be hidden.

patches_modified.name: Show seekbar thumbnail
patches_modified.description: Shows TikTok's video preview thumbnail while dragging the seekbar.

patches_modified.name: Stop video looping
patches_modified.description: Stops videos at the end instead of replaying them.

patches_modified.name: Translate comments
patches_modified.description: Adds comment translation controls using TikTok's translation system, with selectable language exclusions.
